test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The students must complete the assignment by Friday.

options.text: The assignment must be completed by the students by Friday.
The assignment will be completed by the students by Friday.
The students will have completed the assignment by Friday.
The assignment must be complete by Friday by the students.

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• The original sentence is in the active voice, and to convert it to the passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.

• The modal verb 'must' remains unchanged when transforming the sentence from active to passive voice.

• The phrase 'by the students' is added to indicate who is performing the action in the passive voice.

• The verb 'complete' changes to 'be completed' to form the passive voice structure.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: *The assignment must be completed by the students by Friday*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Option 2 ('The assignment will be completed by the students by Friday.') incorrectly changes the modal verb 'must' to 'will', altering the meaning and sense of obligation present in the original sentence.

• Option 3 ('The students will have completed the assignment by Friday.') remains in active voice and changes the tense, making it an incorrect transformation.

• Option 4 ('The assignment must be complete by Friday by the students.') is a less preferred construction due to awkward phrasing and redundancy in the placement of 'by the students'.
